title.narrative: Operating Al-Jaada Health Center in Hayran District, Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Saving life, preserving its continuity, reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics, and providing emergency health services.

Saving lives, preserving their continuity, reducing the spread of diseases and epidemics, providing basic health, nutritional and reproductive health services, providing dialysis services, supporting the health sector in some of the liberated districts of Hajjah Governorate and settling them.

The health center is fully prepared to begin providing integrated, specialized and nutritional health care services to 101,470 beneficiaries in integrated health care services, children’s and women’s health, therapeutic nutrition services, immunization services, reproductive health services, treatment of those infected with epidemics, protecting them from infection with epidemics, providing bandaging and follow-up services, and reducing complications. Injuries and their infections / Providing radiology and laboratory services according to the need for the health condition / Preserving the environment and preventing the spread of epidemics by burning waste in the incinerator designated for that / Continuing the work of the health center with medical, technical and administrative staff to provide health services and providing medicines and laboratory solutions Continuing the operation of the equipment and serving patients according to their condition Health
